title: Kainos's top framework-access score is now evidenced on 15 lots across 8 Crown Commercial Service frameworks
content:
The correction on Kainos changes the status of a number without changing the number. Framework access had been asserted at 5 with no evidence behind it; verification confirmed 5, backed by 15 lots across 8 Crown Commercial Service frameworks. The digit is identical and its decision value is not.

That distinction matters for the corpus as a whole. An asserted score and a verified score look the same in a ranking, and the correction log is the only place the difference is recorded. Any downstream use of these scores that reads the columns without the flags will treat guesses and findings as interchangeable.

The row also carries a tension. Kainos has maximal public-sector framework access, verified, plus a deep proprietary stack — Workday as Europe's largest boutique partner, Microsoft Solutions Partner, AWS Advanced Consulting and Premier MSP with 500+ certified engineers — across public, NHS and banking verticals. It nonetheless sits in the do-not-pitch tier, and the flag does not say which input produced that placement; the row is a provisional v2 entry with an OSS-portfolio screen still outstanding.
